question: Which company will be the world's 2nd most valuable by market cap on December 29, 2026?

calls.reasoning: CompaniesMarketCap (Wed Nov 25 close): Apple 5.17T, MSFT 3.638T, NVDA 3.605T, GOOG 3.331T, AMZN 2.64T. NVDA +~4.9% premarket Black Friday puts it ~3.78T, narrowly ahead of MSFT. With ~21 trading days left and NVDA's extreme vol (31% one-day jump on Huang reinstatement, -27% month, congressional testimony Dec 1-2 and a public Senate hearing in December), the relative NVDA/MSFT 1-month sigma is ~18%, so the 2-3% gap gives only a slight NVDA edge. Alphabet needs ~8-9% relative gains vs both leaders (~13%). Apple is 2nd only if someone passes it (~35-40% relative move, ~3.5%). Polymarket 2nd-largest end-Dec (thin, $142k, Dec 31 date): NVDA 47/MSFT 34/GOOG 14/AAPL 6, consistent.
calls.reference_class: Month-ahead rank among near-tied megacaps: lognormal relative-move model using estimated implied vols (NVDA ~75%, MSFT ~35%, GOOG ~40%, correlation ~0.55) applied to current market-cap gaps
